title: Arithmetic Foundations
tagline: Adding, taking away, times tables and the order of operations.

skills.title: Adding and subtracting
skills.objective: Add and take away two-digit numbers, and go below zero.

skills.title: Multiplying and dividing
skills.objective: Use times tables to multiply and divide.

skills.title: Order of operations
skills.objective: Work out a calculation with more than one operation in the right order.

levels.title: Add and Subtract
levels.objective: Add and take away two-digit numbers, one column at a time.

lesson.intro: Line the numbers up by place value: ones under ones, tens under tens.
steps: Add the ones first. If they make ten or more, carry a ten.
Then add the tens, with any ten you carried.
To take away, start with the ones. If the top digit is smaller, borrow a ten.

levels.title: Multiply and Divide
levels.objective: Use times tables to multiply, and divide by thinking of them backwards.

lesson.intro: Multiplying is adding equal groups. Dividing shares into equal groups.
steps: To divide 48 ÷ 6, ask: what times 6 makes 48?
A times table fact works both ways.
lesson.remember: Know one fact, and you know its division too.

levels.title: Order of Operations
levels.objective: Work out brackets first, then × and ÷, then + and −.

lesson.intro: Not every calculation goes left to right.
steps: Then multiply and divide, left to right.
Then add and subtract, left to right.

levels.title: Number Challenge
levels.objective: Show you can add, subtract, multiply, divide and use the order of operations.

lesson.intro: Everything from this path, a little harder.
steps: Below zero: 4 − 9 counts down past zero.
Mixed: brackets, then × and ÷, then + and −.
